input.rationale: Article VIX provides the Licensed Technology wholly "AS IS", disclaims all express and implied warranties (including title, accuracy and non-infringement), and expressly negates any assurance that nonconformity to the Documentation will be corrected. There is no affirmative performance or conformance warranty anywhere in the Agreement: the only related obligation is Article VII's "commercially reasonable efforts" to provide Error Corrections during the term, which is a support covenant rather than a warranty and carries no repair/replace/refund remedy. That places the Agreement in the rule's walk-away category (AS IS with no conformance warranty), failing even the fallback of 90 days for software with a real remedy. Redline inserts a 12-month software conformance warranty plus workmanlike-services, legal-compliance and no-malicious-code warranties with a repair/replace/refund remedy, and carves the express warranties out of the disclaimer; a 90-day period is available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Add express performance/conformance warranty with repair-replace-refund remedy and carve it out of the AS IS disclaimer
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently provided wholly "AS IS" with no conformance warranty or remedy, which we cannot accept; we have added a 12-month conformance warranty for the Software, a workmanlike-services and no-malicious-code warranty, and a repair/replace/refund remedy, and carved these out of the disclaimer. If helpful, we can fall back to a ninety (90) day software warranty period.
